*Symptoms:*
• ALL modern .NET services show *zero APM traffic* for 9+ hours (since ~00:00Z): `ms-gateway-api`, `runtime-core-api`, `ms-account-api`, `ms-tables-fields-api`, `oauth2`, `ms-identity-api`
• Gateway `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` returning XHR errors to *multiple customers* simultaneously (consultantengineeringservicepllc, arkimportexportcenterllc, deccanfoods4, ecoscapeuk, and more — 08:22–09:15Z)
• `ms-account-api` sub-services (mongodb, redis, sql-server) all *No Data* since 03:09Z
• Watchdog APM/infrastructure story fired at *08:58Z* (monitor 236570583)
• Centreon fired 4 infra alerts in 08:49–08:58Z
• *Synthetics Midnight run* still Alert (monitor 123495390)
• *Signup SLO* breached since 2026-04-29 (3+ days)
• Frontend: Redux Error #7 (reducer undefined) in `method-platform-ui` and `PlatformCtrl not a function` (synthetics, 09:04Z)
• Elasticsearch blocked (403) — backend exceptions unavailable
*Trace IDs:* None available (no APM traffic)

*Root deploys correlated to outage start:*
• `runtime-core` @ 2026-05-01T18:50Z: `b1f93583` — Revert "currency symbols for money fields" (#2657)
    ◦ This reverted `5bdf280` (currency), but may have introduced a DI wiring regression from the previous commit `898e5d4` (Add caching to LegacyPermissions — `GetLegacyPermissionsAndBundlesCommand`)
• `method-platform-ui`: `6d1a4d2` — Revert currency feature (#5735); `92585aa` — Revert email API v2 (#5728)
*Likely cause:* IIS `runtime-core` app pool crashed or stopped after the b1f9358 revert deploy. Suspected: DI container wiring failure — `GetLegacyPermissionsAndBundlesCommand` registered via `898e5d4` cache change, then the revert broke its dependency graph. Result: all runtime-core endpoints (runtime, designer, RestApi, apps) stop responding, and the gateway has no backend to proxy to.

*Suggested next action:*
1. :red_circle: *SSH to prod server → check IIS Manager → is `runtime-core` app pool running?* If Stopped, check Windows Event Log for startup exception
2. If pool stopped due to startup crash: `git log runtime-core --since="2 days ago"` and check if rolling back to pre-898e5d4 resolves
3. Check if `GetLegacyPermissionsAndBundlesCommand` DI registration is correct after the revert
4. `method-platform-ui`: check if Redux Error #7 is a result of `6d1a4d2` revert leaving a stale reducer reference

Channel: `alert-frontend-errors`  -  confidence: 0.65  -  bug-type guess: *code + env*

*Symptoms (08:14–09:18Z, multiple customers):*
• *Gateway XHR failures* on `/gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/<account>/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` across at least 4 distinct customer accounts (ecoscapeuk, deccanfoods4, arkimportexportcenterllc, consultantengineeringservicepllc, and trustviewaccountingandtaxservices). Customers are logged in and see the legacy UI but the QuickBooks sync widget can't reach the gateway.
• *Redux Error #7* ("Reducer's returned value is undefined") — occurring repeatedly at 08:24–08:25Z. This is a JavaScript-layer regression, likely from `method-platform-ui` revert `6d1a4d2` (Revert "Users should see currency symbols for money fields in card columns" #5735). If that revert removed a reducer but left dispatched actions still referencing it, reducers return undefined.
• `PlatformCtrl is not a function, got undefined` — AngularJS 1.5.8 controller load failure, seen from HeadlessChrome (synthetics, 09:04Z) at `Public.aspx` — likely the Synthetics test surface, not real users.
• `_AutofillCallbackHandler is not defined` — benign browser extension artifact (7 occurrences 08:22Z), low signal.
*Trace IDs:* None (ES blocked 403; Datadog RUM log IDs not actionable as trace IDs)

*Likely causes (two separate issues):*
1. *Gateway syncutil failures* — downstream of the P0 backend outage (see `#alert-system` primary DM). The gateway is down or the syncutil IIS backend it routes to is unavailable. Same root: b1f9358 revert.
2. *Redux Error #7* — potentially an independent regression from `method-platform-ui` revert `6d1a4d2`. Worth checking the diff: did the revert remove a Redux reducer that is still referenced in selectors/mapDispatchToProps?
*Suggested next action:*
1. Pull `git diff 92717d0..6d1a4d2` on `method-platform-ui` — look for any deleted reducer in `src/redux/` or `apps/m-one/src/store/` that still has live `dispatch` callers
2. Gateway syncutil failures will auto-resolve once backend P0 is resolved
3. ES blocked (403) — investigate why ES creds are 403-ing (separate infra issue)

:rotating_light: _new alert — needs human_
Channel: `alert-frontend-errors`  -  confidence: 0.62  -  bug-type guess: `env`

*Symptoms:*
• Datadog monitor 77419271 ("Unusual number of XHR errors for account") fired at 16:44:13 UTC (12:44 EDT)
• `GET /gateway/syncutil/syncwidget/<account>/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` returning *status=0 "Failed to load"* (network abort) across 10+ accounts simultaneously
• Top offenders in window: `inversionesroda` (11 errors), `aandmdiscountfurniture4` (11), `OverlandParkKansas` (4), `mustangnorth` (2)
• 50 log events in the 16:40–16:50 UTC window
*Trace IDs:* None — status=0 means requests never reached a traced service

*Likely cause:* The `GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync` sync widget XHR is being aborted (status=0, `err_origin: network`) before completion for high-traffic accounts. Backend `classic/syncservices` is healthy: ~2500 hits/30s, zero traced errors. Two hypotheses:
1. High-traffic accounts exceed the >40 XHR/5min threshold via accumulated request cancellations (users navigating away while widget loads) — a *monitor sensitivity* issue
2. Periodic transient unavailability of the syncutil endpoint (possibly IIS app pool recycling) causing bursts of network failures
*Baseline comparison:* 50 logs at 16:40–16:50 UTC yesterday (same rate — no spike today)
*Prior occurrence:* Same pattern already flagged at 10:13Z EDT (~2.5x baseline then); recurred at 12:44Z EDT (normal baseline now). Pairs firing ~every 2–4 hours today (04:14, 10:13, 12:44 EDT).
*Monitor status:* Back to OK (transient — lasted <5 min)
*Deploys:* Only currency-symbol reverts in `method-platform-ui` + `runtime-core` in last 24h; no sync-path changes

*Suggested next action:*
• If hypothesis 1: update monitor 77419271 to exclude `status:0` (aborted requests) — these are not real errors
• If hypothesis 2: check IIS app pool recycle schedule for the `legacy` or `syncservices` pool; look for a ~2-4h recycle interval
• Either way: consider adding this pattern to `kb/false-alarms.json` if confirmed as noise
